# RRC Success Rate Degradation in Sahel Sites

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SAH-002`
- **Confidence:** medium (The timing of changes CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, and CHG-2026-0028 directly matches the anomaly onset at 10:15-10:23 on the affected sites. Maintenance windows, transport failures, and other external factors were checked and ruled out via tools T2, T4, T7, T8, T9, T10, and T11. External events were not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-10 10:15 to 2026-09-10 12:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-10 10:23
- **Affected:** S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, S-SAH-008

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to sites S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008, causing an immediate RRC success rate degradation and drop rate spike.

RRC success rate fell and drop rate spiked across sites S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008 starting at 2026-09-10 10:15, and the impact ended following the subsequent rollback of the changes.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 09:22: Warning TEMP_HIGH raised on S-SAH-008. [ALM-000193]
- 2026-09-10 09:46: Warning TEMP_HIGH cleared on S-SAH-008. [ALM-000193]
- 2026-09-10 10:15: Anomaly alert ALR-0010 started, indicating drop rate spike and RRC success drop on S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008. [T1, ALR-0010, ANM-000163, ANM-000162]
- 2026-09-10 10:23: Scheduled parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 applied to S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008 via changes CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, and CHG-2026-0028. [T3, T5, CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, CHG-2026-0028]

## Evidence

- An anomaly alert ALR-0010 started on 2026-09-10 10:15 affecting sites S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008 with a drop rate spike and RRC success percentage drop. [T1, ALR-0010, ANM-000163, ANM-000162]
- Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to S-SAH-002, S-SAH-007, and S-SAH-008 at 2026-09-10 10:23. [T3, T5, CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, CHG-2026-0028]
- No transport failures, maintenance windows, or active changes on upstream transport links/routers occurred that could explain the degradation. [T4, T7, T8, T9, T10, T11]
- Runbook guidance confirms that parameter tuning regressions match the observed signature. [T12, RB-BAD-CHANGE#02]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SAH-002: confirmed. Parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 was applied to the affected sites at 10:23, precisely correlating with the performance regression, and was subsequently rolled back. [CHG-2026-0026, CHG-2026-0027, CHG-2026-0028, RB-BAD-CHANGE#02]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-A: rejected. No changes or critical transport failures occurred on the parent links or aggregation routers during the incident window. [T8, T9, T10, T11]
3. **power_failure** at S-SAH-008: rejected. The TEMP_HIGH warning on S-SAH-008 cleared well before the onset of the RRC success rate degradation and did not recur. [ALM-000193]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000193: The temperature warning on S-SAH-008 occurred and cleared prior to the performance degradation and is unrelated.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch OPT-21 settings before any future deployment.
- Verify post-rollback KPI recovery across all affected sites.
